Beans, kidney, red, mature seeds, canned, drained solids

scale_cues: Stainless steel mixing bowl roughly 25-30 cm across fills the frame; chicken cubes were sized against the bowl width (about 1.5-2 cm each). Bean size was compared with the chicken cubes.
assumptions: No sauce, dressing, or visible added oil identified; any residual oil or marinade on the meat is included in the chicken estimate.
Beans assumed to be canned kidney beans, drained.
Chicken assumed to be cooked breast meat, since the pale color and dense cube texture fit breast rather than thigh.
Visible mass is approximately the total on the plate; hidden pieces under the surface are not accounted for beyond the visible count.
